study: COLLA - the missing glue of nuclear binding in the Skyrme-knot model

common.lattice: c4 stencil (knot2_core), h = 0.2, Dirichlet vacuum; L = 48 for alpha=0 runs, L = 52 for the GHS scan
common.binding: B_bind = B*M_1 - M_B, same lattice and same model for both terms
common.parameter_count: every route lists: physical constants used, fit inputs, extra free parameters

routes.C0: classical massless Skyrme (NUCLEI_DA_NODI): 2 fit inputs (M_N, M_Delta) -> d 72, 3He 178, 4He 310 MeV
routes.C1: pion mass m_pi = 138 MeV (constant of nature, 0 extra free parameters) + refit of (e, F_pi) to M_N, M_Delta
routes.C2a: rigid-rotor spin/isospin quantisation (0 extra parameters), AN units; d: J=1 I=0 -> hbar^2/V_11; 3He: J=I=1/2 with K+L=0 (assumed, as the hedgehog) -> (3/4)(u+v+2w)/(2(uv-w^2)) hbar^2; 4He: J=I=0 -> 0; nucleon M_N = E_1 + 3 hbar^2/(8 Lambda)
routes.C2b: zero-point energy of the BOUND vibrational modes (omega < m_pi) of B=1 and B=2 (0 extra parameters), generalised eigenproblem K xi = omega^2 2M xi on the lattice; continuum (Casimir) NOT included
routes.C3a: Gillard-Harland-Speight lightly bound potential, 1 extra parameter alpha (m=1 as GHS): scan alpha = 0, 0.5, 0.8, 0.95
routes.C3b: sextic term c6 B0^2 added to the AN massive model, 1 extra parameter c6: c6 = 50, 200 (Skyrme units)

exams.C1a: AN refit reproduces Adkins-Nappi F_pi = 108 MeV and e = 4.84 within 2 %
exams.C1b: lattice E_1 (AN m) within 1 % of the 1D hedgehog
exams.C1c: shapes kept with physical pion mass: B=2 torus (asym C_ax 30/45/90 deg < 0.02, one hole), B=3 tetrahedron (C2x,C2y,C2z,C3 asym < 0.02, inversion asym > 0.3), B=4 cube (Cz90,C3,inv asym < 0.02)
exams.C1d: PREDICTION 'pion mass alone does not fix binding': classical d binding > 10 x 2.22 MeV AND 4He > 3 x 28.3 MeV
exams.C1e: literature check m=1 (alpha=0 point of the C3a scan): B=4 cube E/(12 pi^2 B) = 1.307 within 1 %
exams.C2a-i: lattice B=1 (AN) inertia: U, V, -W diagonal within 3 % of the 1D Lambda
exams.C2a-ii: torus tensors: U11=U22, V11=V22 within 1 %; |V33|/U33 = 4 and |W33|/U33 = 2 within 3 %; |W11|/U11 < 0.02
exams.C2a-iii: PREDICTION: rigid quantisation with M_N fitted to 939 MeV makes binding LARGER than classical for d and 4He
exams.C2a-iv: deuteron rigid-rotor binding within a factor 2 of Braaten-Carson's 158 MeV
exams.C2b-i: zero modes found: 6 for B=1 and 8 for B=2 with omega^2 < 0.05 m^2 (lattice breaks translations slightly)
exams.C2b-ii: PREDICTION: zero-point of bound modes REDUCES the d binding (Delta_zp > 0) but d binding after C2a+C2b stays > 10 x 2.22 MeV
exams.C3a-i: GHS alpha=0.95 1D E_1/8pi^2 = 1.1082 within 1 %; lattice binding per nucleon B=2, B=4 = 1.84, 4.56 MeV within 30 % (E_1 := 938.27 MeV)
exams.C3a-ii: binding fraction of B=2 and B=4 decreases monotonically with alpha (0, 0.5, 0.8, 0.95)
exams.C3a-iii: PREDICTION shapes: alpha <= 0.5 torus and cube kept; alpha = 0.95 B=2 and B=4 are separate lumps (B=2 not a ring: ring_center_over_max > 0.3 or 2 peaks; B=4 not a cube: inversion asym > 0.1 or 4 peaks)
exams.C3a-iv: ONE-PARAMETER FIT then PREDICTION: alpha* fixed so that 4He binding = 28.3 MeV (log-linear interpolation in the scan, declared fit); predicted d binding at alpha* within a factor 2 of 2.22 MeV and 3He within a factor 2 of 7.72 MeV
exams.C3b-i: PREDICTION: sextic term lowers the binding fraction monotonically but at c6 = 200 the 4He binding stays > 3 x 28.3 MeV (AN units)
exams.C4: summary table route x (params, d, 3He, 4He, shapes) and recommendation for the agglomerator

notes: Start fields: relaxed massless N1 fields (rm1..rm4) + 2 % random noise (to let symmetric saddles fall); for alpha=0.95 also product-ansatz starts (pair d=2.5, tetrahedron edge 2.5, attractive channels); the lowest energy is kept.
AN units: E_u = F_pi/(4e), hbar = 2e^2; GHS scan uses GHS calibration E_1(classical) = 938.27 MeV, alpha=0 point idem.
Each script <= 10 min with checkpoints, 2 threads total.
